subject: Working directory error for runModels command?

messages.author: 22a57de4594acf61
messages.subject: Working directory error for runModels command?
parts:
Dear list,

I am new to MplusAutomation, and I am trying to use the runModels command to run several models in one folder. However, I keep getting the following error message:

> runModels('MplusAutomation')

Running model: A_N=50T=5ICC=05.inp 
System command: cd "MplusAutomation" && "/Applications/Mplus/mplus" "A_N=50T=5ICC=05.inp" 
Error in setwd(dirtocd) : cannot change working directory

This is if I've set the working directory to the folder that contains the folder "MplusAutomation", which contains the input files I want to run. However, if I try using the whole path to the folder, I get the following error message:

> runModels('Users/frefa24/OneDrive/Monte Carlo therapist effects/MplusAutomation')
Error in runModels("Users/frefa24/OneDrive/Monte Carlo therapist effects/MplusAutomation") : 
  runModels cannot change to directory: Users/frefa24/OneDrive/Monte Carlo therapist effects/MplusAutomation

I saw some other people having reported similar problems a couple of years ago, but none of the fixes that were suggested works for me.

I am using a Macintosh computer, with the following R version:

R version 3.6.1 (2019-07-05)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin15.6.0 (64-bit)
Running under: macOS Mojave 10.14.6

The version of MplusAutomation is MplusAutomation_0.7-3.

Best,

Fredrik Falkenström
